args.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL is defined as `process.env.PUBLIC_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000"`, so whenever the PUBLIC_URL environment variable is unset or not wired up correctly in the deployed environment, every generated link (including the password reset link) silently falls back to localhost instead of failing loudly or using the real public URL. This matches the reported behavior where reset emails point to http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=….

Proposed fix: source the public base URL from the application's config module (e.g. config.publicUrl) rather than reading process.env directly with a localhost fallback, and ensure that config value is required/validated at startup (or throws clearly) when missing in production, instead of defaulting to localhost. This keeps templates.ts from ever producing a localhost link in a deployed environment, and surfaces a clear configuration error if PUBLIC_URL truly isn't set.
